tac_surface_normal — 2D tactile op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "tac_surface_normal", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

The type contract is image → image. For what it does in words, see the family usage guide and the runnable samples below (nothing is guessed here).
